verdict.rationale: Docs show a clear @tool/Tool subclass pattern with `name`, `forward` method, and typed inputs for defining custom tools, plus minimal agent creation examples (CodeAgent/ToolCallingAgent) that consume these tools in a few lines. Community evidence corroborates real usage of the tool-calling loop, though it also shows friction (e.g., import restrictions causing failures) rather than a clean happy path every time. Missing for 10: explicit end-to-end code snippet combining a typed custom tool definition with agent instantiation in the evidence pack, and independent third-party validation of ease-of-use beyond the one HN thread.
